name: tom_base
prompt: Cinematic film still, 35mm, shallow depth of field. Portrait of Tom, a man of 35 from a Northern European city: short dark-blond hair slightly messy, light stubble, tired but kind grey-blue eyes, a straight nose, an ordinary likable face, not a model. He wears a plain charcoal hoodie. Night, dark bedroom, his face lit only by the cool blue light of a phone held below frame, rain-streaked window behind him with blurred orange city lights. Natural skin texture, subtle film grain, muted teal and amber grade, Netflix documentary look.
